answers.core: I believe it will be used often if people knew it existed. Many users are likely misusing `_exit_tree()`, or are simply not freeing up their allocated (non-ref-counted) members, or are just using the `_notification()` workaround because they have to. It would not be a stretch to say that the lack of this method encourages and proliferates bad memory management practices, for the simple fact that Godot requires some things to be explicitly freed, yet does not provide a dedicated place to do this.
